rule: Every upstream file under packages/durable that changed, appeared or disappeared between the pins, and every packages/chord file a phase 4 chord row names, is in exactly one area's upstream list or one excluded entry; other changed Chord files are excluded as phase 6. A file several areas change belongs to the area that changes most of it (ties go to the later area; a Chord v2 area owns only files no other area changes), alsoChangedBy names the others, and every one of them lists the file's C# counterpart under pisharp; each area ports its rows' v1.5.0 behaviour there, and the last of them in order to land brings the C# file to the v1.5.0 blob and re-pins its citation (the sync's citation rule: only a file that matches every upstream file it cites at v1.5.0 moves to the v1.5.0 commit). The order is an order the areas can be ported in, not upstream's chronology. Every phase 4 applicability row is in exactly one area's applicabilityRows. A port map row moves from needs-sync or planned to ported only when its owning area lands with its tests passing. Waves run in parallel worktrees: their areas have no dependsOn between them and disjoint pisharp sets (test Program.cs files and the port map may be shared, with additive edits only).

sizeScale.S: under 300 lines of work; a day or less of C#
sizeScale.L: 1500 to 4000 lines; about one to two weeks, may need several landings
sizeScale.XL: over 4000 lines, or a new runtime capability to build in C#; split before starting
sizeScale.measure: workLines: the src and test lines the area's upstream commits changed in the files attributed to it (docs and packaging excluded); a Chord v2 area, which has no commits in this filter, uses upstreamLines, and the closeout is sized by its re-pin sweep (M), not by lines. upstreamLines sums the range diff of the files the area owns (added and removed files count their full length), as in the 1.2.0 list.

It moves the Durable suite's report label (tests/PiSharp.Durable.Tests/Program.cs Upstream, on v1.2.0 during the sync) to v1.5.0 and DurableUpstream.cs's line 1 citation once index.ts is ported; DurableWire.DurableVersion (Client Wire.cs, "1.2.0") is the pi-durable version the device wire announces: move it to 1.5.0 only if the device protocol keeps durable-pi compatibility at 1.5.0 (area events), otherwise leave it and say why. The upgrade case group upgrade-from-v1.2.0 (a v1.2.0-written corpus opened by v1.5.0 code, like upgrade-from-v1.1.0) lands here if the format areas have not added it. Moves every port map row to ported whose area landed with its tests passing, and checks that no needs-sync or planned row is left outside phase 6. The renamed examples (05-harness to 30-reload-and-restart) changed only their numbers unless a listed area owns them: their C# files keep their names, so only their citations move. Session/SessionStatesCases.cs was deleted by area watches (2cce573d), so this area no longer edits it.

excluded.reason: pi-durable docs and packaging; no C# counterpart. docs/spec.md is the normative reference every area ports against (decision 0005) and docs/group-commit.md is area group-commit's reference; README's Errors section is area settled (durable.storage-request-errors). package.json drops typebox (area tools-schema), adds the chord/output, chord/sqlite and storage/indexeddb entry points and the store test pass that vitest.store.config.ts wires (area store-storage ports it as case groups); CHANGELOG.md is the bullets the applicability table maps.

IndexedDbStorage, a browser storage over IndexedDB, and its test: .NET does not target the browser (durable.indexeddb-storage is no-op, area settled; revisit only if a Blazor WebAssembly Durable host is planned). The Storage contract changes it follows are area storage-batches.
Durable Object SQLite drivers and their tests: Cloudflare adapters are out of scope (decision 0005; durable.cloudflare-adapters and chord.sqlite-cloudflare are no-op).

workerd tests of Durable Object hosting (storage over a Durable Object, wake() under hibernation): Cloudflare, out of scope under decision 0005 (durable.cloudflare-adapters is no-op, area settled). The generic wake() behaviour they exercise is ported from harness-sleep.test.ts in area sleep.

Checks that importing the code mode extension leaves pi-codemode's WASM QuickJS runtime unloaded, a JavaScript module-graph property; PiSharp runs Jint and has no module graph (port map: skipped; durable.codemode-declarations-import is no-op, area codemode).
Live-provider end-to-end tests (the port map marks them skipped: they need live provider credentials, and tests stay faux and offline). 2331785c3 only moved one to another model.

phase 6: the Chord v1 host runtime (cells, clusters, connections, contracts, hosts, links, loaders, managers, objects, records, registries, reload, remote, schema, WebSocket, wire) and its tests, which pi-durable imports nothing from; CHANGELOG.md is the bullets the applicability table maps.

Chord docs and packaging that phase 4 rows name; no C# counterpart. delta/README.md documents appendText (area chord-append-text reads it); docs/next/*.md and store/book.md are the Chord v2 design, decisions, slice plans and store book the Chord v2 areas read; package.json adds the output, sqlite, next and telemetry-sqlite entry points.
phase 6: Chord docs no phase 4 row names (Chord v1 guide, spec and tutorial; Chord v2 slices, books and diagrams).

phase 6: cheaper container copies in applyImmutable (d0aa218cb), a JavaScript copy-cost change; its rows are chord.delta-container-copies (no-op) and chord.delta-core (already-ported), both phase 6, and no phase 4 row names it. Its port map row stays needs-sync for phase 6.
phase 6: Chord v2's Node adapters (HTTP, plugins, workers: chord.next-http, chord.next-plugins, chord.next-workers) and their tests.

Chord v2's host runtime (9,412 lines: hosts, objects, attempts, references, routes, routines, staging). chord.next-registries names the directory, but the host belongs to chord.next-host-objects (phase 6): the registries import nothing from it, and pi-durable's src imports only RegistryValue's shape. The registry tests and durable's registry-reader test build registries through createHost; areas cv2-registries and registry-reader say which cases wait for phase 6.
phase 6: Chord v2 layers no phase 4 row names (jobs, links, remote: chord.next-jobs, chord.next-links-remote).

phase 6: Chord SQLite pieces no phase 4 row names (the Durable Object driver test, chord.sqlite-cloudflare no-op; the WAL replication files added and removed in the range; telemetry-sqlite, chord.telemetry-sqlite).
phase 6: Chord delta tests no phase 4 row names (chord.delta-owned-slice, chord.delta-tracker-open-change, chord.delta-container-copies).
phase 6: Chord v2 tests no phase 4 row names (host, jobs, links, remote, examples, benchmarks).

order: settled: nothing to land; listed first so its rows are accounted for
harness-options: self-contained options of 1.3.0 to early 1.5.0 on the core files; the system baseline fix lands first, as its row asks
chord-watch: new Chord files only; Durable's watches move onto it in area watches
chord-append-text: Chord tracker change that partial-commits needs; independent of Durable's core
chord-output: the output move and its clock, which sleep needs; touches only Output.cs and Truncate.cs
sqlite: storage formats first: schema v2 must exist before a sleeping task is stored; independent of the harness
storage-batches: batch Storage.commit for every IStorage right after sqlite, which is all it needs; the Session sends one batch per call until group-commit
env: independent env API change; lands with the phase 2 deferral (Windows shell install directories)
tool-search: independent ranking port; the differential flips here; touches Codemode.cs before codemode
tools-schema: pi-schema tools early, right after tool search, so every later area ports its new upstream tests with pi-schema declarations already in place
checkpoint-when: wide mechanical change across PiSharp-only definitions; early, before the areas that edit the same consumers
model-requests: request plumbing (identity, payload hook, thinking level) before telemetry wires pi.ai.poll into the same model adapter
sleep: 1.4.0 task semantics that wake, restarts and the scheduler index build on; needs sqlite and chord-output
codemode: the Harness clock in code mode right after sleep adds api.now()
reports: the Report shape every later area reports through (host_error, task_outdated)
telemetry: needs reports (host_error telemetry); touches every core file, so it runs alone
watches: Durable's watches onto Chord's Watch; first of the watch/observer chain
watch-folding: folding and address-following on the new watches
partial-commits: appendText-based partial commits; deferred commits plan through partial-changes
deferred-commits: deferred persistence of partial commits, before group commit changes the write path
observers: synchronous observers the view, events and publication build on
view: windowed view and transcript, which the event projection renders from
run-failure: pi.live.runFailure, which events, restarts, admission and turn limits use
events: watchEvents removal and the PiSharp-only projection, after view and run-failure
restarts: restart limit and interrupted requests; needs run-failure, reports, telemetry and sleep
vocabulary: the cross-cutting rename of commit observers and ends after observers exist
tool-tasks: tool task results and pi.tool v3 after restarts (restart_limit results)
admission: continue, whenIdle and submit(tx) after run-failure and telemetry
live-turns: pi.live v2/v3 at once, after admission (shared example 33)
run-end: entry reads and afterRun after admission (submit inside a commit)
group-commit: the Session writer over batch storage
group-commit-scheduler: the scheduler half of group commit
publication-caches: publication order and read caches on top of the writer
scheduler-idle: last scheduler change: lands last on scheduler.ts and brings Scheduler.cs to v1.5.0
cv2-contracts: Chord v2 starts at its contracts
cv2-evolve: contract evolution on the declarations
cv2-data: data on contracts
cv2-state: state on data and chord-watch
cv2-store-sql: the store's query layer
cv2-store-tables: tables on the query layer
cv2-store-engine: the engine and commitSeries on tables and the SQLite layer
cv2-store-archive: export and import on the engine
cv2-documents-core: documents on state and the store
cv2-documents-slots: slots and transactions on the documents core
cv2-registries: registries on state and data
store-storage: Durable on the store, after storage-batches and the store and documents areas
registry-reader: registryReader on Chord v2 registries
closeout: last: re-pins what the areas left, moves the suite label, closes the port map
